primary_intents.name: Late Delivery
primary_intents.definition: Customer's package has not arrived by the expected delivery date
primary_intents.why_exists: Most common delivery problem - specific action available (check status, expedite, refund)
primary_intents.common_confusion: Often overlaps with ORDER_STATUS - but here customer knows package exists, just late

primary_intents.name: Missing/Not Delivered
primary_intents.definition: Customer never received package, shows delivered but not there
primary_intents.why_exists: Different action than late - may need refund or replacement faster
primary_intents.common_confusion: May overlap with LATE if customer unsure

primary_intents.name: Tracking Issue
primary_intents.definition: Customer cannot track package or tracking information is wrong

primary_intents.name: Carrier/Logistics Problem
primary_intents.definition: Issue with delivery carrier (Gati, etc.) causing delivery problems
primary_intents.common_confusion: Often a sub-issue of other delivery problems
primary_intents.how_to_distinguish: Keywords: carrier names, 'delivery partner', specific carrier complaints

primary_intents.name: Order Status Inquiry
primary_intents.definition: Customer wants to know status of order, where it is, when arriving
primary_intents.how_to_distinguish: Customer is asking for information, not requesting change

primary_intents.name: Order Modification/Cancellation
primary_intents.definition: Customer wants to change or cancel their order
primary_intents.why_exists: Different action path than status inquiry

primary_intents.name: App/Website Issue
primary_intents.definition: Problem using Amazon app or website (not working, error, can't find something)

primary_intents.name: Device Problem
primary_intents.definition: Issue with Amazon device (Kindle, Fire TV, Echo, Alexa)
primary_intents.common_confusion: May need to distinguish from general APP issue

primary_intents.name: Video/Streaming Issue
primary_intents.definition: Problem with Prime Video, streaming content, subtitles, playback

primary_intents.name: Account Access Problem
primary_intents.definition: Customer cannot login, access account, password issues, account locked
primary_intents.why_exists: Different action path than other issues
primary_intents.common_confusion: May overlap with APP_USAGE (login via app)

primary_intents.name: Refund Request
primary_intents.definition: Customer wants money back for order, payment, or subscription
primary_intents.why_exists: Clear customer action - want money back
primary_intents.common_confusion: Overlaps with RETURN but different request

primary_intents.name: Payment Problem
primary_intents.definition: Issue with payment method, billing, credit card, gift card
primary_intents.why_exists: Different from refund - problem with payment process itself

primary_intents.name: Return/Exchange Request
primary_intents.definition: Customer wants to return item or get replacement

primary_intents.name: Product Quality/Defect
primary_intents.definition: Customer received wrong, damaged, or defective product
primary_intents.why_exists: Often leads to RETURN but distinct problem

context_modifiers.name: Prime Customer
context_modifiers.definition: Customer is a Prime member - affects delivery expectations
context_modifiers.usage: Add as modifier/context, not primary intent

escalation_signals.name: High Frustration
escalation_signals.definition: Customer expresses anger, frustration, or strong negative emotion

escalation_signals.name: Previous Unresolved Contact
escalation_signals.definition: Customer mentions contacting before with no resolution

escalation_signals.name: Escalation Request
escalation_signals.definition: Customer explicitly asks for manager, supervisor, or callback

escalation_signals.name: Service Quality Complaint
escalation_signals.definition: Customer complains about Amazon service quality
escalation_signals.action: Log for quality tracking, consider escalation

proposed_hierarchy:
HIERARCHICAL PROPOSAL (Recommended):

TOP LEVEL (6 categories):
├── DELIVERY (40-45%)
│   ├── DELIVERY_LATE
│   ├── DELIVERY_MISSING
│   ├── DELIVERY_TRACKING
│   └── DELIVERY_CARRIER
├── ORDER (10-15%)
│   ├── ORDER_STATUS
│   └── ORDER_MODIFY
├── TECHNICAL (25-30%)
│   ├── APP_USAGE
│   ├── DEVICE_ISSUE
│   └── VIDEO_STREAMING
├── ACCOUNT (3-5%)
│   └── ACCOUNT_ACCESS
├── REFUND_PAYMENT (8-13%)
│   ├── REFUND_REQUEST
│   └── PAYMENT_ISSUE
└── RETURN_PRODUCT (6-10%)
    ├── RETURN_REQUEST
    └── PRODUCT_ISSUE

FLAT ALTERNATIVE (if simpler taxonomy needed):
10-12 primary intents without hierarchy

RECOMMENDATION: Hierarchical with 14 leaf intents
- Easier to explain and understand
- Allows aggregation to top-level for high-level routing
- Sub-intents are meaningful for retrieval and training
